meta.note: All entities synthetic. Feature weights and calibration are the live pipeline's; precision/recall are measured against planted labels. Outputs are decision-support indicators, not final determinations.

models.name: MCC Miscoding Detector
models.summary: Declared MCC vs. observed acceptance behaviour. Fires when a merchant's channel, timing and ticket profile do not match the category it settles under.
models.detects: Merchants coded into a benign MCC while transacting like a prohibited or restricted vertical.

calibration.normalization: peer z-score (same-MCC cohort, shrunk to global for thin peers)

models.name: Split-Ticket Burst Detector
models.summary: Bursts of near-identical, near-ceiling authorizations on the same card within a short window — one sale sliced under the floor limit.
models.detects: Ticket splitting to stay below authorization or review ceilings.

features.label: Share of txns inside a split burst

calibration.normalization: peer z-score (same-MCC cohort, shrunk to global for thin peers)

models.name: Factoring / Aggregation Detector
models.summary: One acquiring shell settling for many undisclosed sub-merchants — sub-merchant fan-out, descriptor sprawl and volume spikes with low name coherence.
models.detects: Transaction laundering: a host processing third-party volume it never underwrote.

calibration.normalization: peer z-score (same-MCC cohort, shrunk to global for thin peers)

models.name: Descriptor Intelligence
models.summary: Churning, generic or URL-laden billing descriptors that drift away from the registered DBA name — a concealment tell independent of content.
models.detects: Descriptor manipulation used to evade name-match monitoring and cardholder recognition.

calibration.normalization: peer z-score (same-MCC cohort, shrunk to global for thin peers)

models.name: Interchange-Abuse Detector
models.summary: A large positive interchange advantage sitting on a card-not-present profile inside a category that should be card-present (grocery / fuel / charity).
models.detects: MCC chosen for a cheaper interchange band than the behaviour warrants — a revenue-integrity class, not a prohibited-content class.

calibration.normalization: peer z-score (same-MCC cohort, shrunk to global for thin peers)

rules.name: interchange_abuse_rule
rules.expr: interchange_advantage_bps > 50 on a cheap band  OR  CNP-vs-expected > 0.55 with advantage > 25

models.name: Cash-Disbursement Detector
models.summary: Very round, high-ticket, repeat-card draws against a merchant whose declared category is not a permitted cash outlet.
models.detects: Quasi-cash extraction / factoring-for-cash outside licensed cash MCCs.

calibration.normalization: peer z-score (same-MCC cohort, shrunk to global for thin peers)

rules.name: undeclared_quasi_cash_rule
rules.expr: pct_quasi_cash > 0.25  AND  MCC not in cash bands

models.name: Integrity Composite
models.summary: The portfolio risk score. A single weighted combination of the strongest cross-typology signals — not a max over the sub-models, which would inflate every merchant. Binned into Low → Critical tiers.
models.detects: Any merchant whose overall behaviour departs from its declared category, across all six typologies at once.

features.label: Share of txns inside a split burst

metrics.gtNote: vs. any planted integrity violation or interchange abuse

contentBank.name: MCC-Miscoding Content Bank
contentBank.summary: Eleven behavioural fingerprints for the prohibited / restricted verticals a miscoder hides inside. The argmax names the likely concealed category; the P1/P2/P3 rollup is the reliable, audited read.
contentBank.detects: Which prohibited vertical a miscoded merchant most resembles.
contentBank.note: Within-category argmax attribution is directional on saturated scores; the P1/P2/P3 tier detection is measured against planted labels.

rulePack.name: Expert Rule Pack
rulePack.summary: A transparent, non-ML complement to the scorers. Each gate is a hard, auditable threshold; a merchant reaches the queue via the model OR the rules, so a clean-scoring merchant that trips a rule is still surfaced.
rulePack.detects: Bright-line policy breaches that must fire regardless of the learned score.

rules.name: undeclared_quasi_cash_rule
rules.expr: pct_quasi_cash > 0.25  AND  MCC not in cash bands

rules.name: interchange_abuse_rule
rules.expr: interchange_advantage_bps > 50 on a cheap band  OR  CNP-vs-expected > 0.55 with advantage > 25
